facts.fact: 9/20：Sienna 储物柜被写巨型红字 CARPET MUNCHER——她对着拍照围观的人群喊话：你们给了那些人权力。
facts.anchor: CARPET MUNCHER written across it in huge red block letters.

facts.fact: Sienna 的性向真相首度揭露：她其实不是同性恋——Reds 偏偏知道真相；「我有时真希望自己是，那样就能告仇恨犯罪」。
标签来源：Delaney 撞见 Sienna 在地下室派对和 Craig Peterson 接吻——而 Craig 是 Delaney 从七年级起就在笔记本上涂鸦的人。
facts.anchor: Delaney caught me making out with Craig Peterson

facts.fact: Collins 的课：每个作家都留下「指纹」——句法、用词、节奏、标点习惯，独一无二的身份标记。
facts.anchor: about authorial voice. Or, more specifically, something I like to call an author’s fingerprints

facts.fact: 抄袭案：有同学交了别人写的故事，而「原作者毫不知情」——Collins 不点名。
facts.anchor: One of your classmates handed in a story that was not written by them.

facts.fact: 下课后 Collins 单独留下 Peyton——抄袭者就是她。
facts.anchor: “Peyton,” Mr. Collins says, his voice stern. “A word, please.”

facts.fact: Max 的核心疑问：Peyton 到底怎么拿到她的小说的？
facts.anchor: How the hell did Peyton get her hands on one of my stories in the first place?

facts.fact: 线索拼图收紧：Misty 突然重修旧好→来家里发现笔记本→坚持上学日办睡衣派对——Sienna 的怀疑全对上了。
校车上 Sienna 到家前一直挺直，进门瞬间肩膀垮下——Max 看见全校都看不到的那个她。
facts.anchor: the Sienna nobody at school ever gets to see.

facts.fact: 笔记本全失窃，连装它们的盒子也不见了——Max 自认幸存者，但这次她觉得自己撑不过去。
facts.anchor: They’re gone. My notebooks are all gone.

facts.fact: Misty 用「Milo 会在」诱她上车，还带上 Kayla 当帮手。
facts.anchor: Not even a party Milo will be at?

facts.fact: 篝火旁全是 Reds——Misty 不是带她来派对，是把她送进埋伏；「Told you I'd get her here」（我跟你说过我会把她带来）。
facts.anchor: She delivered me into an ambush.

facts.fact: 背叛实锤：Kayla 和 Misty 手腕都绑着红绳——Misty 是 Fairhope Red。
facts.anchor: the red string tied around her wrist too.

facts.fact: 焚稿：Peyton 逼她下跪乞求，一本本烧掉她多年的故事——「我要看你哭」「求我」。
facts.anchor: Watch her feed years of my life into the flames, one notebook at a time.

facts.fact: 结局自判：精神没被摧毁，但心碎了——Peyton 成功了。
facts.anchor: Not my spirit. She doesn’t get to have that. But my heart? That she broke.

facts.fact: 死亡威胁：Peyton 贴耳低语——我知道你爸何时不在、你何时出门、何时回家、何时睡觉；「我不做威胁，我只做承诺」。
facts.anchor: I know when you go to sleep.
